utilitycraft:deepslate_aetherium_ore.description: Deepslate Aetherium Ore is a world-generated ore with its base loot and optional StatsCore mining modifiers documented separately.

modifiers.title: Alternative Drop
modifiers.copy: The normal and Fortune amounts are listed in the drop table above.

modifiers.title: Crushing
modifiers.copy: Adds one mapped Dust without replacing the normal loot.

modifiers.title: Bonus Loot
modifiers.copy: When Bonus Loot succeeds, it adds the mapped resource according to the tool chance and detected drop amount.

modifiers.title: Double / Triple Trouble
modifiers.copy: Double Trouble adds one complete extra loot-table roll; Triple Trouble can add a second one.

utilitycraft:absolute_container.description: A high-density, all-in-one Dorios network container for items, energy, and one fluid type.
blockDetails: 173 total slots · indices 168 and 169 display energy and fluid
All 168 storage slots accept both input and output; it stays active and exposes item, energy, and fluid interfaces to the network.
